card.name: Numbers in military unit designations
card.fires_on: Numbers, ordinals and linking words such as "of" that sit right before a military unit's number or name, as in "Squadron 6", "3rd Combat Aviation Brigade" or "soldiers of the 3d Infantry".

modes.label: Unit numbers
modes.description: A digit or ordinal ending (rd, d, th) in the name of a numbered military unit.
modes.example: the US Army’s 3<<rd>> Combat Aviation Brigade based at Bagram,

modes.label: Linking "of" before a unit
modes.description: The word "of" after a section, soldiers or an officer, leading into a named military unit.
modes.example: the 1,200 soldiers<< of>> the 3d U.S. Infantry

modes.label: Space after unit type
modes.description: The space after a unit type word like Squadron, just before its number.
modes.example: Marine Corps Helicopter Observation Squadron<< >>6, VMO-6, accompanied

card.writes: It pushes toward unit-type words (Chinese terms like workshop, branch, company), suggesting a unit or organization name comes next.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers and small words in names of army, air force and other military units.
